per_window.ps-ns: Isolated wild-type CTD (25 °C, pH 6.5, perdeuterated): flexible termini only (J1, r10); the beta-barrel core is rigid with average S2 0.83 (J2, r10, measured_not_detected); the unfolded B state moves on about 1 ns in beta1*/beta2* and alpha5* (J3, r11). Full-length autoinhibited RfaH: linker 101-114 is mobile (J14, r29, r1) and the alpha-hairpin CTD shows no large fast motion (J15). Abstract-only Tudor-domain model-free study, a likely source for the RelaxDB set, is unresolved (J28, r30).
per_window.us-ms: Isolated wild-type CTD: dynamic_in_window. The joint CPMG/CEST five-state fit (35 author-listed residues) gives A↔A' (about 0.35%, tauex about 500 µs, beta1/beta2 loop; J4, r9, r13) and B↔B'/B'' inside the unfolded ensemble (about 0.3% and 0.05%, tauex 0.8-1.3 ms; J5, r9, r14). Full-length autoinhibited RfaH: a 4.9% excited state at 16 °C, pH 6.5 (kex about 335 s-1, mostly NTD; J16, r26), persisting at 2.5 kbar (4.0%, J17, r27, r28); four CTD amides are flat by CPMG at 288 K, pH 7.5 (J18, r18).
per_window.slower_than_ms: Isolated wild-type CTD: folding/unfolding exchange between the beta-barrel and a largely unfolded state, pB 5.53% and kex 14.8 s-1 in protonated eLife samples (J7, r5) versus pB about 25% and tauex about 300 ms in perdeuterated PNAS samples (J6, r8); homolog VcRfaH-KOW pB 0.43%, kex 74.6 s-1 (J31, r7). Full-length RfaH does not visit the beta CTD above 0.2% at 20-200 s-1 (J19, r17). Abstract-only HDX and 19F rows unresolved (J23, J27, J30).
per_window.undetermined: Fold switch without rates: isolated beta-barrel versus alpha-hairpin structures (J10, r3), alpha-to-beta after linker cleavage (J11, r4), reversible conversion on opsEC binding and release (J12, r20, r21), refolding endpoints (J13, r22, r23). RDC averaging in B (J9, r12); eLife minor-state extra exchange (J8, r6); missing N156 amide (J20, r2); HDX-MS uptake differences after 0.5-2 min labelling with no exchange or opening rate: CTD uptake rises on TEC binding (J21, r35) and differs between isolated and TEC-bound beta CTD (J22, r36); MD rows (J24-J26); F126W 19F CEST (J29); proteolysis (J32, r38); unresolved CTD density in collided TTC (J33, r39); FRET/EPR/multitemperature crystallography not measured (J34). Not judged: 19F anisotropic tumbling abstract (r16), NTD-only CPMG dispersion outside the entry (r19), cryo-EM coupled-complex geometries that describe RNAP-ribosome orientation rather than CTD motion (r40, r41).

protein_summary.wt_apo_answer: Yes: the isolated wild-type CTD (beta-barrel) at 25 °C, pH 6.5 shows us-ms exchange in a perdeuterated sample, where a joint 15N CPMG/CEST five-state fit over 35 author-listed residues finds the barrel exchanging with a dark state A' (about 0.35%, tauex about 500 µs, likely the beta1/beta2 loop) and the unfolded state B exchanging with B' and B'' (about 0.3% and 0.05%, tauex 0.8-1.3 ms); slower, the barrel unfolds and refolds (folding/unfolding exchange, not a switch to the alpha-hairpin) with pB 5.5% and kex 14.8 s-1 in protonated samples or pB about 25% and tauex about 300 ms in perdeuterated samples.
open_conflicts: Unfolded-state population of the isolated CTD at 25 °C, pH 6.5: 5.53 ± 0.46% with kex 14.8 s-1 (r5; protonated, native 101-162, 20 mM sodium phosphate with 100 mM NaCl) versus about 25% with tauex about 300 ms (r8, r9; perdeuterated, native 102-162, 25 mM potassium phosphate, no NaCl). kAB agrees (about 0.8 s-1) but kBA differs (14 versus 2.4-2.8 s-1); the rows do not say which sample difference causes it.
A'↔A lifetime: about 500 µs in the PNAS Results and Fig. 6, about 1 ms in its abstract (r9).

Full-length autoinhibited RfaH: CPMG is flat at CTD F123, G135, M140, L145 at 288 K, pH 7.5 in 10 mM phosphate (r18), while at 16 °C, pH 6.5 in 50 mM phosphate with glycerol 32 residues disperse with small Δω inside the CTD helices (r26). Temperatures nearly match but pH, buffer and probes differ, and r26's CTD residue list is in an inaccessible SI table; treated as a condition difference, not a conflict.
questions_for_gina: Which sample supplied the RelaxDB RFAHTD R1/R2/NOE set? The input links 2LCL (Cell 2012, isolated CTD 101-162) and no BMRB id; the Tudor-domain model-free paper (r30) is a likely source but was read only as an abstract.

For the WT apo answer, should the A↔B folding/unfolding exchange (kex 3-15 s-1, tauex 70-300 ms) count as slower_than_ms as done here, and which isolated-CTD sample (protonated pB 5.5% or perdeuterated pB 25%) should RelaxDB labels be compared with?
protein_summary.buffer_note: Row ids are written RFAHTD-rN. Isolated-CTD constructs (native 101-162 or 102-162) are scored construct WT and is_wt_apo true because they contain the whole entry (native 111-162) and are the state the entry represents; the 9-10 extra linker residues lie outside the entry. Full-length RfaH, opsEC- or TEC-bound RfaH, the E48A and F126W variants and the V. cholerae homolog are is_wt_apo false. All isolated-CTD NMR and most full-length NMR use 10-50 mM sodium or potassium phosphate, often with EDTA, at pH 6.5-7.5; no row shows a phosphate or EDTA artefact and no buffer comparison exists, while HDX-MS used Tris with 5 mM MgCl2. The PNAS main text prints 95% D2O/5% H2O, the SI and captions 95% H2O/5% D2O. Window convention: exchange with tauex above about 10 ms (kex below about 100 s-1) is placed in slower_than_ms, faster exchange in us-ms. CEST minor states that resemble the unfolded domain are folding/unfolding exchange, not fold switching. Row RFAHTD-r42 now states that the simulations were run in that paper, as the second-read adjudication found; J26 treats them as run there.
